rationale.en: The Attorney General's summary describes a one-time tax of up to 5 percent on certain taxpayers with covered assets valued over $1 billion. The Analyst says billionaires who were California residents on January 1, 2026 would pay a one-time state tax equal to 5 percent of their net worth, due in 2027, payable over five years at extra cost. Context: the tax rests on residency on January 1, 2026, and the FPPC list calls the measure a tax on "certain individuals and trusts".
